name: Jacob Ballas Children's Garden
summary: Children's garden in the Singapore Botanic Gardens with nature trails, an edible garden and a water play area with mist, wading pools and water jets.
location: Singapore Botanic Gardens, 1H Cluny Road, Singapore 259604 (near Botanic Gardens MRT)
notes: Tue–Sun 8am–7pm, last admission 6.30pm; closed Mondays except public holidays. For children 12 and under; adults enter only with a child. Changing areas and outdoor showers for water play; no food outlet inside. Short link redirects to sbg.nparks.gov.sg.

name: Far East Organization Children's Garden (Gardens by the Bay)
summary: Free children's garden with a Toddler Play Zone for ages 1 to 5, including a swaying bridge, stepping springs and a fish fountain with water tunnels.
location: Gardens by the Bay (Bay South), entrance near the Sun Pavilion; nearest carpark: Satay by the Bay
notes: Thu–Sun and public holidays 9am–7pm (last admission 6pm; water play closes 6.30pm). During school holidays also open Tue–Wed (school year-end holidays run 21 Nov–31 Dec 2026). Toddler Play Zone is for ages 1–5; the main Water Play and Rainforest Tree Houses are for ages 6–12. Entrance moved near the Sun Pavilion from 26 Mar 2026 because of bridge works.

name: Flower Dome (Gardens by the Bay)
summary: Air-conditioned glass conservatory with flower gardens and rotating seasonal displays; easy stroller walk on hot or wet days.
location: Gardens by the Bay, 18 Marina Gardens Drive, Singapore 018953
price_note: Paid admission; resident and non-resident rates differ. Check the official site.
notes: Daily 9am–9pm. Seasonal displays: Christmas Train Show 20 Nov 2026–3 Jan 2027; Spring Blossoms (Lunar New Year) 15 Jan–28 Feb 2027. The neighbouring Cloud Forest currently features a Jurassic World experience, which may frighten some toddlers.

name: Active Garden and PropNex Family Zone (Gardens by the Bay)
summary: Free waterfront play area with an inclusive family playground, a musical playground with xylophone and drums, and open lawns.
location: Gardens by the Bay (Bay South), near Bayfront Plaza Carpark
notes: Daily 5am–2am. Pets allowed. Nearest carpark: Bayfront Plaza. Also has a community edible garden.

name: KidsSTOP (Science Centre Singapore)
summary: Children's science centre for ages 8 and under, with hands-on zones such as a supermarket, flight and space area and a dinosaur dig pit.
location: 21 Jurong Town Hall Road, Singapore 609433 (beside Science Centre Singapore, Jurong East)
price_note: Children under 18 months free. Child (18 months–8 years) about $10 peak / $5 off-peak and accompanying adult $5 / $2 at local rates, as reported 11 Oct 2026; check official ticketing.
notes: Still open at the current Jurong East site as of Oct 2026; the Science Centre's planned move to a new building in the Jurong Lake District has not happened yet. Two sessions Tue–Sun: 10am–1pm and 2pm–5pm (closed 1–2pm for cleaning); closed Mondays except public and school holidays. Book a session before going. Private-event closures: 10, 11 and 19 Nov 2026, 10am–1pm. science.edu.sg returns HTTP 202 (bot check) to curl; page confirmed via Google index and Wayback Machine (Sep 2026).

name: Children's Museum Singapore
summary: National Heritage Board museum for young children, with immersive exhibitions about Singapore's past.
location: 23B Coleman Street, Singapore 179807 (Armenian Street area)
price_note: Level 1 free from 29 Sep to 12 Nov 2026. Admission terms for the new exhibition from 14 Nov 2026 not yet published.
notes: Level 2 closed from 28 Sep 2026; whole museum closed 13 Nov 2026; new exhibition opens 14 Nov 2026. No specific toddler age guidance found. heritage.sg returns HTTP 403 to curl; page confirmed via Google index and Wayback Machine (Oct 2026).

name: Keppel Centre for Art Education (National Gallery Singapore)
summary: Free hands-on art space in the National Gallery with themed play zones, a book nook and daily drop-in art activities.
location: National Gallery Singapore, City Hall Wing Level 1, 1 St Andrew's Road
notes: Open daily; closes 12.30–1pm and 3.30–4pm for cleaning; last entry 6.40pm. Designed for ages 4–12, so younger toddlers need close help. Stroller parking at entrance; wheelchair accessible. Expect up to 30-minute waits on busy weekends. Toddler sessions run separately (see GalleryToddlers!).

name: Future World at ArtScience Museum
summary: Permanent teamLab digital art exhibition where children can draw sea creatures that appear on a projected aquarium and play with light and sound installations.
location: ArtScience Museum, 6 Bayfront Avenue, Marina Bay Sands
price_note: Paid. Concession tickets for children aged 2–12; aggregator lists from $19 adult / $14 child. Check the official site.
notes: Opens 10am. Rooms are dark with bright projections; may overwhelm some babies. marinabaysands.com timed out to curl during checks; page confirmed via Wayback Machine snapshot (2 Oct 2026).

name: PIP's PLAYbox (Esplanade)
summary: Free children's arts space with a loft, craft area, reading corner of Singapore picture books and an outdoor play area.
location: Esplanade – Theatres on the Bay, Level 4, 1 Esplanade Drive, Singapore 038981
price_note: Free for Esplanade&Me members (free Discover tier available). Craft kits by donation.
notes: Mon–Sun 11am–6pm, closed 2–3pm for cleaning. Register at entrance (everyone, including infants). Shoes off; no food. Nursing room on Level 4 outside PLAYbox (8am–6pm) and on Mezzanine level (8am–9pm); children's toilets and stroller parking on Level 4. Was closed 8–12 Oct 2026 for the F1 race.

name: Central Library (National Library Building)
summary: Lending library in the basement of the National Library Building with the Children's Biodiversity Library by Singapore Oceanarium.
location: 100 Victoria Street, Basement 1, Singapore 188064 (near Bugis / Bras Basah MRT)
notes: Has a nursing room and programme rooms. Reopened Jan 2024 after renovation. Hosts Early READ Fiesta 5–6 Dec 2026. Public libraries are typically open 10am–9pm daily; check NLB for holiday hours. nlb.gov.sg returns HTTP 202 (bot check) to curl; page confirmed via Google index and Wayback Machine (Mar 2026).

name: library@harbourfront
summary: Public library in VivoCity with a large children's section and sea views.
location: VivoCity Level 3, 1 HarbourFront Walk (HarbourFront MRT)
notes: Children's section includes interactive features such as a Tinker Truck and AR books (per TheSmartLocal, 2021; check current layout). Typically 10am–9pm daily. nlb.gov.sg returns HTTP 202 (bot check) to curl; URL confirmed via Wayback Machine (200 snapshot Nov 2025).

name: Punggol Regional Library
summary: Singapore's largest public library, with an early literacy area and toy library on Level 1 and a children's zone on Level 2.
location: One Punggol integrated hub, Punggol
notes: Includes calm pods and sensory kits for children with additional needs. Hosts Early READ Fiesta on 21 Nov 2026. Floor layout per Little Day Out. nlb.gov.sg returns HTTP 202 (bot check) to curl; URL confirmed via Wayback Machine (200 snapshot Jan 2026).

name: Woodlands Regional Library
summary: Regional library with a nature-themed children's section and sensory-friendly reading areas.
location: 900 South Woodlands Drive, #01-03 Woodlands Civic Centre, Singapore 730900
notes: Hosts Early READ Fiesta 13–14 Nov 2026. Children's section features per TheSmartLocal (2021). Typically 10am–9pm daily. nlb.gov.sg returns HTTP 202 (bot check) to curl; URL confirmed via Wayback Machine (200 snapshot Nov 2025).

name: Tampines Regional Library
summary: Five-storey regional library in Our Tampines Hub with a dedicated young children's level.
location: Our Tampines Hub, 1 Tampines Walk, #02-01
notes: Our Tampines Hub also has other family facilities. Typically 10am–9pm daily. nlb.gov.sg returns HTTP 202 (bot check) to curl; URL confirmed via Wayback Machine (200 snapshot Jan 2026).

name: Jurong Regional Library
summary: Regional library next to Jurong East MRT with a children's section and regular baby and toddler storytimes.
location: 21 Jurong East Central 1, Singapore 609732
notes: Listed as 'Jurong Library' in NLB's programme calendar. Planned move to the Jurong East Integrated Transport Hub (reported for around 2028); still at current site. Hosts Early READ Fiesta 19–20 Mar 2027. nlb.gov.sg returns HTTP 202 (bot check) to curl; URL confirmed via Wayback Machine (200 snapshot Nov 2025).

name: Singapore Zoo
summary: Open-concept zoo with shaded paths, animal feedings and KidzWorld, which has a wet play zone.
location: 80 Mandai Lake Road, Mandai Wildlife Reserve, Singapore 729826
price_note: Tickets from S$34 child / S$49 adult (Mandai, Mar 2026). Residents can get discounts with the free WildPass.
notes: Daily 9am–6pm, last admission 5pm. Mandai suggests 3–4 hours. Bring swimwear and a change of clothes for KidzWorld water play.

name: Bird Paradise
summary: Large bird park with walk-through aviaries, a penguin habitat and Egg Splash, an egg-themed playground with wet and dry play zones.
location: 20 Mandai Lake Road, Mandai Wildlife Reserve, Singapore 729825
price_note: Tickets from S$34 child / S$49 adult (Mandai, Mar 2026). WildPass resident discounts.
notes: Daily 9am–6pm, last admission 5pm. Egg Splash closed from 2.30pm on 10 Nov 2026 until 12 Nov 2026 for maintenance. Penguin Cove is indoor and air-conditioned.

name: River Wonders
summary: River-themed wildlife park with freshwater habitats and aquariums, giant pandas, Indian gharials and Mekong giant catfish; much of it is shaded or indoors.
location: 80 Mandai Lake Road, Mandai Wildlife Reserve, Singapore 729826
price_note: Tickets from S$33 child / S$45 adult (Mandai, Mar 2026). WildPass resident discounts.
notes: Daily 9am–6pm, last entry 5pm. Mandai suggests about 2 hours, a manageable length for toddlers.

name: Rainforest Wild Adventure (Mandai)
summary: Adventure-themed rainforest park with an elevated walkway, animal habitats and play areas such as a canopy playground and lemur-inspired trampolines.
location: Mandai Wildlife Reserve, 80 Mandai Lake Road (EAST and WEST zones)
price_note: Paid admission; check official site. WildPass resident discounts.
notes: Daily 9am–6pm, last entry 5pm. Elevated walkway has step-free access for strollers. Most Adventure+ activities (zipline, swings) are for older children; toddlers mainly walk the trails and visit the play areas. Formerly Mandai Rainforest Wild ASIA.

name: Curiosity Cove (Mandai)
summary: Large indoor, air-conditioned nature playscape for children 12 and under, with four animal-habitat zones and daily dance sessions with Ranger Buddies mascots.
location: 80 Mandai Lake Road, Mandai Wildlife Reserve, Singapore 729826
price_note: From S$48 for one child plus one adult (Mandai, Mar 2026). Weekday play unlimited except school holidays.
notes: Mon–Fri 10am–5.30pm (last entry 4.30pm); Sat, Sun, school holidays and public holidays 10am–6.30pm (last entry 5.30pm). Halloween event 'The Mischief Within' running in Oct 2026.

name: Singapore Oceanarium (formerly S.E.A. Aquarium)
summary: Resorts World Sentosa's expanded aquarium, which replaced S.E.A. Aquarium in July 2026, with 22 zones, a shark tunnel and a large open-ocean viewing panel.
location: Resorts World Sentosa, 24 Sentosa Gateway, Singapore 098137
price_note: Paid. Children under 4 free; adult from about S$55 and child (4–12) from about S$43 per ticket resellers. Check official site.
notes: Officially opened July 2026. Stroller-friendly. Opening hours not readable from the official page by script; resellers list roughly 10am–7pm daily, so check the official operating-hours page. Marine Mammal Habitat viewing panel temporarily closed. Official site returns HTTP 403 to plain 'Mozilla/5.0' curl but 200 to a full browser user agent.

name: Sensoryscape (Sentosa)
summary: Free 350-metre garden trail with six themed gardens that use scent, sound, touch and light; it links Resorts World Sentosa to the southern beaches.
location: Sentosa, between Resorts World Sentosa and Imbiah Station
notes: Open 24 hours. ImagiNite light and AR show 7.30–9.15pm daily. Wheelchair accessible. Good stroller walk before or after the Oceanarium.

name: Coney Island Park
summary: Rustic island park linked to Punggol by bridges, with boardwalks, a beach and varied natural habitats.
location: Beside Punggol Promenade Nature Walk; West entrance near Punggol Point Walk
notes: Open 7am–7pm. Paths are mostly unpaved; a rugged stroller or carrier works better. Little shade in places.

name: Admiralty Park
summary: The north's largest park, with many play elements including 26 slides, plus mangrove and nature areas.
location: 31 Riverside Road, Singapore 730000 (use West entrance carpark)
notes: Open 24 hours; nature area 7am–7pm. Slides are graded by age; follow the age signs. North entrance closed permanently since Aug 2023.

name: Woodlands Waterfront Park
summary: Quiet park with a large playground and a waterfront promenade facing the Straits of Johor.
location: Admiralty West Road, Woodlands
notes: Open 24 hours. Carpark along Admiralty West Road. On the Northern Explorer Loop park connector.

name: Punggol Waterway Park
summary: Riverside park through Punggol town with four themed zones, paved paths for stroller walks and play areas.
location: Along Sentul Crescent, Punggol
notes: Open 24 hours. The old water play area near Carpark B was demolished around 2022 (per Little Day Out); do not expect water play here.

name: Sengkang Riverside Park
summary: Park along the Punggol River with a man-made wetland and rich birdlife; good for nature walks with a stroller.
location: Junction of Anchorvale Street and Sungei Punggol (near Kupang / Farmway LRT)
notes: Open 24 hours. A section of track is closed for pipe works until 31 Dec 2026; follow detour signs.

name: East Coast Park and Coastal PlayGrove
summary: 13 km seaside park with sand, shady lawns and Coastal PlayGrove, which has a play tower, water play pools and a nature playgarden.
location: Along East Coast Parkway; Coastal PlayGrove at the former Big Splash site
notes: Park open 24 hours. Coastal PlayGrove water play: 8am–8pm Tue–Sun, closed Mondays, recommended ages 5–12. Nature playgarden: 24 hours, recommended ages 3–12. Beach sand play suits younger toddlers. Box jellyfish advisory for sea entry.

name: Pasir Ris Park
summary: Seaside park with Singapore's largest playground, a mangrove boardwalk and pony rides.
location: Pasir Ris (several entrances; Carpark A at Area 1)
price_note: Free park; pony rides and water sports are paid.
notes: Open 24 hours. Carpark A (Area 1) is closest to many facilities.

name: Bishan-Ang Mo Kio Park
summary: Large central park with a naturalised river, a water playground with sluice gates, an inclusive playground and an adventure playground with toddler swings.
location: Ang Mo Kio Ave 1 (5 minutes from Bright Hill MRT)
notes: Park open 24 hours. Water playground: Thu–Sun and public holidays, 8–11am and 4–8pm (NParks). Inclusive and adventure playgrounds open 24 hours; adventure playground has bucket swings and small structures for toddlers.

name: Jurong Lake Gardens (Forest Ramble and Clusia Cove)
summary: Large western park with Forest Ramble, a nature playground based on swamp animals, and Clusia Cove, a sand-bottomed water play area that mimics tides.
location: Yuan Ching Road, Jurong (10 minutes from Lakeside MRT)
notes: Forest Ramble and Clusia Cove are closed on Mondays (and on Tuesday if Monday is a public holiday). Water play hours not stated on the page checked. Chinese and Japanese Gardens reopened Sep 2024.

name: West Coast Park
summary: Park branded the 'Play Centre of the West', with an adventure playground and wide lawns.
location: West Coast Highway, near Clementi
notes: Open 24 hours. Part of the Area 1 footpath closed for repairs until 31 Dec 2026.

name: HortPark
summary: Gardening hub on the Southern Ridges with themed display gardens; good for easy, shaded stroller walks among plants.
location: 33 Hyderabad Road, Singapore 119578
notes: Open 6am–11pm. Visitor services 9am–12pm and 1–5pm weekdays, 8.30am–12.30pm weekends and public holidays.

name: Sungei Buloh Wetland Reserve
summary: Wetland and mangrove reserve and ASEAN Heritage Park with boardwalks for spotting birds and mangrove wildlife.
location: Kranji (bus 925 from Kranji MRT)
notes: Open 7am–7pm, last entry 6.30pm. Some areas close at high tide or in bad weather; check closure notices. Bring insect repellent.

name: Canopy Park (Jewel Changi Airport)
summary: Indoor garden attraction on Jewel's top level with Foggy Bowls (gentle mist play), a petal garden, topiary walk and discovery slides.
location: Jewel Changi Airport, Level 5, 78 Airport Boulevard
price_note: Canopy Park ticket SGD 8 standard, SGD 6 Singapore residents. Child tickets are for ages 3–12. Nets and mazes cost extra.
notes: Mon–Thu 10am–9pm; Fri–Sun, eve of public holidays and public holidays 10am–10pm; last admission 30 minutes before closing. Child ticket holders must be with a paying adult.

name: Rain Vortex (Jewel Changi Airport)
summary: The world's tallest indoor waterfall, surrounded by indoor greenery, with evening light and music shows.
location: Jewel Changi Airport, 78 Airport Boulevard
notes: Daily 10am–10pm. Light and music shows Mon–Thu 8pm and 9pm; Fri–Sun, public holidays and eves 8pm, 9pm and 10pm. Air-conditioned and stroller-friendly.

name: Changi Airport public-area play spots
summary: Free play areas in the airport's public areas, including an airplane-themed playground at Terminal 3 Basement 2 for ages 2 to 5.
location: Changi Airport Terminals 1 and 3 (public areas)
notes: Terminal 3 B2 airplane playground (ages 2–5) and Terminal 1 Level 2 viewing gallery playground per Little Day Out (June 2026); the official page lists family play areas but does not detail these. Many play areas are in transit zones for passengers only.

name: Baby Lapsit (NLB libraries)
summary: Free 30-minute session of songs, rhymes and finger plays for babies under 1 and their parents.
location: Various public libraries (recent sessions at Bedok, Clementi, Choa Chu Kang, Yishun)
notes: Register on NLB's GoLibrary calendar, one ticket per person (parent and baby each need one). Attendance taken by scanning a QR code in the NLB Mobile app. Arrive 15 minutes early; late seats may go to walk-ins. Usually weekend mornings around 11.30am. Upcoming: 31 Oct 2026 (Bedok, Clementi); 15, 18, 21 Nov 2026 (Choa Chu Kang). Runs islandwide, so region is set to central as a default.

name: Jiggle, Read & Rhyme (NLB libraries)
summary: Free 30-minute parent-child session of songs, rhymes and stories to support early literacy for toddlers aged 1 to 3.
location: Various public libraries (recent sessions at Toa Payoh, Jurong, Ang Mo Kio)
notes: Register on NLB's GoLibrary calendar, one ticket per person. Parents must stay. Upcoming: 25 Oct 2026 (Toa Payoh, Jurong), 29 Nov 2026 (Ang Mo Kio), all 11.30am. Screen-lite activity under Grow Well SG. Runs islandwide, so region is set to central as a default.

name: MOLLY the Mobile Library weekend outreach
summary: NLB's mobile library bus visits neighbourhoods on weekends so families can browse and borrow books for all ages close to home.
location: Rotating HDB estates and community centres (e.g. Teck Ghee View, Woodleigh Link, Marine Drive, Whampoa CC)
notes: No registration. Example schedule at Teck Ghee View (332 Ang Mo Kio Ave 1): 24 Oct, 28 Nov and 26 Dec 2026, 9am–12pm. Locations change; check the GoLibrary calendar. Region set to central as a default because stops are islandwide.

name: GalleryToddlers! (National Gallery Singapore)
summary: Monthly 40-minute sensory play session for toddlers aged 2 to 3, based on a different artwork each month.
location: National Gallery Singapore, City Hall Wing (Keppel Centre for Art Education / Singapore Courtyard)
recurrence: First Saturday of each month, 10.30am and 11.30am
notes: Usually the first Saturday of the month; registration opens monthly. Next confirmed session: 7 Nov 2026, 10.30–11.10am and 11.30am–12.10pm. English only.

name: Community centre baby and toddler courses (onePA)
summary: People's Association community centres and residents' networks list paid parent-child and playgroup courses for young children on onePA.
location: Community centres and residents' networks islandwide
price_note: Varies by course. Example: Playgroup at Compassvale Lodge RN, 14 sessions 2–20 Nov 2026, $240 plus material fees.
notes: Search onePA by age and location; offerings change each term and some are run by private operators. Example course is for ages 18 months to 3 years 11 months (children only, not parent-accompanied). Region set to central as a default because courses are islandwide.

name: PLAYtime! (Esplanade)
summary: Esplanade's interactive theatre series for children aged 3 to 6, with 45-minute floor-seated shows in a relaxed setting.
location: Esplanade – Theatres on the Bay, 1 Esplanade Drive
price_note: Tickets from $23 in 2026; every patron, including infants in arms, needs a ticket.
recurrence: Several short runs a year; weekday 9.30am/11am and weekend 11am/2pm/4pm shows
notes: Only suits children who have turned 3. 2026 runs were Jan–Feb (Burp), May (Together) and Aug (The Amazing Sarong); 2025 had runs in Feb–Mar, May and Aug. No run in Oct 2026–Mar 2027 is listed as of 18 Oct 2026; based on past years the next run is likely early 2027 (unconfirmed).

name: Early READ Fiesta at Woodlands Library
summary: NLB's early-literacy fair for children 0 to 6, with storytelling, interactive stations and activity booths.
location: Woodlands Regional Library, 900 South Woodlands Drive
notes: Early READ Fiesta 2026/2027 ('Where Reading Meets Discovery!') for ages 0–6: storytelling, interactive stations and a token for completing all stations; 10am–5pm. Dates from NLB's GoLibrary listing for the pre-Fiesta booth, which lists all four Fiesta stops; individual Fiesta-day listings were not yet posted on 18 Oct 2026.

name: Early READ Fiesta at Punggol Library
summary: NLB's early-literacy fair for children 0 to 6, with storytelling, interactive stations and activity booths.
location: Punggol Regional Library, One Punggol
notes: Early READ Fiesta 2026/2027 ('Where Reading Meets Discovery!') for ages 0–6: storytelling, interactive stations and a token for completing all stations; 10am–5pm. Dates from NLB's GoLibrary listing for the pre-Fiesta booth, which lists all four Fiesta stops; individual Fiesta-day listings were not yet posted on 18 Oct 2026. Same day: bilingual Chinese/English story 'Who Ate My Biscuit?' at 11.30am.

name: Early READ Fiesta at Central Library
summary: NLB's early-literacy fair for children 0 to 6, with storytelling, interactive stations and activity booths.
location: Central Library, National Library Building, 100 Victoria Street
notes: Early READ Fiesta 2026/2027 ('Where Reading Meets Discovery!') for ages 0–6: storytelling, interactive stations and a token for completing all stations; 10am–5pm. Dates from NLB's GoLibrary listing for the pre-Fiesta booth, which lists all four Fiesta stops; individual Fiesta-day listings were not yet posted on 18 Oct 2026.

name: Early READ Fiesta at Jurong Library
summary: NLB's early-literacy fair for children 0 to 6, with storytelling, interactive stations and activity booths.
location: Jurong Regional Library, 21 Jurong East Central 1
notes: Early READ Fiesta 2026/2027 ('Where Reading Meets Discovery!') for ages 0–6: storytelling, interactive stations and a token for completing all stations; 10am–5pm. Dates from NLB's GoLibrary listing for the pre-Fiesta booth, which lists all four Fiesta stops; individual Fiesta-day listings were not yet posted on 18 Oct 2026. Falls in the March 2027 school holidays (13–21 Mar).

name: Who Ate My Biscuit? bilingual storytime (Early READ Fiesta)
summary: Chinese-English story-sharing session about Little Pig's missing biscuit, for children aged 1 to 6.
location: Punggol Regional Library, Programme Room
notes: Part of Early READ Fiesta 2026/2027. Check the listing for registration details.

name: Tiny Tales and Tunes: Baby Shark's Ocean Adventure (Raising Readers Fiesta)
summary: 45-minute parent-baby workshop with songs, lap bounces, sensory props and parachute play based on 'Big Shark, Little Shark, Baby Shark'.
location: Choa Chu Kang Library, Programme Room 1
notes: For babies aged 0–1. Registration required, one ticket per person.

name: Raising Readers Fiesta pop-up activity booths (Bedok)
summary: Three hands-on early-literacy booths: letter matching, building words with popsicle sticks and colour-coded word crafts.
location: Bedok Library, outside Programme Room
notes: For ages 2–6; parents accompany younger children.

name: Musical Stories Vol. 2 by Ensemble Kanon: 'Swimmy'
summary: Live piano, flute and clarinet concert with a musical retelling of Leo Lionni's picture book 'Swimmy'.
location: National Library Building, Lobby, 100 Victoria Street
notes: For ages 1 and above. Walk-in, first come first served.

name: Tamil Storytelling: Vidhaigal
summary: Tamil storytelling session for children aged 1 to 6 and their parents.
location: National Library Building, Imagination Room, Level 5, 100 Victoria Street
notes: Two sessions: 2–3pm and 3–4pm. Slots limited; check the listing for registration.

name: Live Storytelling by My First Skool (Sengkang Library)
summary: English storytelling session by preschool teachers for children aged 3 and above with a parent.
location: Sengkang Library, Early Literacy Area
notes: Walk-in, no registration. For age 3 and above only.

name: Gardens by the Bay Christmas Train Show 2026
summary: Model trains run through miniature landscapes of the United States, Singapore (with SMRT trains) and Finland among Christmas trees and poinsettias.
location: Flower Dome, Gardens by the Bay
notes: Third edition. Air-conditioned and stroller-friendly.

name: Spring Blossoms (Lunar New Year floral display) 2027
summary: Lunar New Year display for the Year of the Goat with kumquats, dahlias, peach blossoms and festive floral sculptures.
location: Flower Dome, Gardens by the Bay
notes: Chinese New Year falls on 6–7 Feb 2027.

name: Christmas Wonderland 2026 (Gardens by the Bay)
summary: Large evening Christmas fair with light installations, foam 'snowfall', carnival rides, a Christmas market and performances.
location: Supertree Grove and The Meadow, Gardens by the Bay
price_note: Ticketed; in 2025 tickets started at $9 adult and $7 child (3–12), under 3 free. 2026 prices not confirmed.
notes: 2026 dates not on the official site as of 18 Oct 2026. ParentLah lists 27 Nov 2026–1 Jan 2027; the 2025 edition ran 29 Nov 2025–1 Jan 2026, 6.30–11pm. Evening timing and crowds may be hard for babies; go early.

name: Christmas on A Great Street 2026 (Orchard Road light-up)
summary: Orchard Road's annual Christmas street light-up and festive activities along the shopping belt.
location: Orchard Road
notes: Official site still shows the 2025 edition (8 Nov 2025–1 Jan 2026) as of 18 Oct 2026. ParentLah lists a 20 Nov 2026 start; end date estimated as 1 Jan 2027 from the 2025 pattern. Covered walkways make it partly rain-friendly.

name: Deepavali light-up and Festival Village, Little India 2026
summary: Street light-up along Serangoon Road and a festive village with stalls and performances for Deepavali.
location: Serangoon Road and Campbell Lane, Little India
notes: Light-up switched on 3 Oct 2026 (LISHA ceremony on Birch Road), lit daily 7pm–midnight. Festival Village on Campbell Lane runs 10 Oct–8 Nov 2026 from 7pm. Deepavali is 8 Nov 2026; 9 Nov is a public holiday. Dates come from a news report and LISHA's Instagram; no official web page found (littleindia.sg did not resolve). Light-up end date not confirmed. Crowded in the evenings.

name: River Hongbao 2027
summary: Chinese New Year festival at Gardens by the Bay with giant lanterns, performances, rides, a food street and fireworks.
location: Gardens by the Bay (2026 venue; 2027 venue not yet announced)
price_note: Free admission in 2026; rides are paid.
notes: 2027 dates not announced as of 18 Oct 2026 (official site still shows 2026). Estimate based on 2026 (15–24 Feb, around CNY on 17 Feb): roughly 4–13 Feb 2027 around CNY on 6 Feb 2027. Fireworks are loud; consider ear protection for babies.

name: Chinatown Chinese New Year Celebrations 2027
summary: Annual Chinatown street light-up and festive bazaar for the Lunar New Year.
location: Chinatown (New Bridge Road, Eu Tong Sen Street, South Bridge Road)
notes: Official site confirms the 2027 celebration (public vote for the centrepiece design closed 19 Jul 2026) but no dates yet. Dates here are a rough estimate (mid-Jan to late Feb 2027, around CNY on 6–7 Feb 2027), not from an official source. Very crowded near CNY eve.

name: Children's Museum Singapore: free Level 1 admission
summary: Free admission to Level 1 of the Children's Museum while Level 2 is being prepared for a new exhibition.
location: Children's Museum Singapore, 23B Coleman Street
notes: Whole museum closed 13 Nov 2026; new exhibition opens 14 Nov 2026. heritage.sg returns HTTP 403 to curl; dates taken from the official page via Google index (Oct 2026).

name: March On 2027 (Esplanade festival for young audiences)
summary: Esplanade's annual March school-holiday festival for young audiences, which in 2026 included Babyzillas, a show for 16–20-month-olds, plus family workshops and sing-alongs.
location: Esplanade – Theatres on the Bay, 1 Esplanade Drive
price_note: Mix of free and ticketed programmes in 2026.
notes: 2027 programme not announced as of 18 Oct 2026. March On 2026 ran 12–25 Mar 2026; 2027 dates estimated to overlap the MOE March holidays (13–21 Mar 2027).
